stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the broader AI/ML ecosystem (transformers, llama, safetensors).

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Boeing is selling its air taxi startups to Archer Aviation
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Boeing is divesting three of its eVTOL subsidiaries to Archer Aviation.
The sale includes Wisk Aero, which focuses on autonomous electric aircraft development.
Boeing is also taking an undisclosed equity stake in Archer Aviation following the transaction.

stories.title: Following Epic loss, Google has started hosting rival app stores in the Play Store
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is integrating rival app stores, specifically Aptoide, directly into the Google Play Store.
This integration is reportedly happening under a court order following legal action against Epic Games.
The move signals a potential shift in the dominance and structure of the Android app distribution ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a specific model, DeepSeek-R1, trending on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational tasks.
Tags indicate its relevance within the transformers and safetensors ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags (transformers, safetensors, llama) confirm its relevance within the modern NLP/AI ecosystem.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.31 introduces significant speed improvements for Gemma 4 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent tasks show up to 90% faster performance according to the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and reduced memory usage for LLMs.
The updated engine also delivers higher quality output from the language models.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes a 'local-first' approach, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating with popular local LLM runners.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, leveraging Apple's native ML framework.
The feature is currently available in a preview release, indicating ongoing development and optimization.

stories.title: Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg’s massive AI manifesto
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg released a lengthy AI manifesto titled "The Future is for Everyone."
The document outlines Zuckerberg's vision for humanity coexisting with artificial intelligence.
The manifesto details his beliefs on the future trajectory of AI development and societal integration.

stories.title: The first rival Android app store just arrived in the US Play Store
stories.author: Dominic Preston
bullet_points: Aptoide, a third-party app store, is now available for download within the US Google Play Store.
This development is linked to ongoing legal battles between Google and Epic Games.
It represents a notable shift, allowing users to access alternative app distribution platforms directly from the Play Store.

stories.title: Peer review is overwhelmed—can it survive in the AI era?
stories.author: Saima Sidik
bullet_points: The peer review process is facing significant strain due to the rapid surge in research output.
The proliferation of AI-assisted papers is exacerbating the workload for volunteer reviewers.
The article questions the long-term viability and sustainability of traditional peer review in the age of advanced AI.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: Addresses a core LLM trade-off: post-training often reduces creativity and diversity.
Introduces 'CreativeInstruct,' a new scalable instruction-tuning method to resolve this conflict.
Aims to balance high output quality (like post-trained models) with necessary creativity and diversity.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a new cognitive architecture designed for LLM agents.
It models human-like memory by separating factual and affective (emotional) memory traces.
Features a conflict-aware executive controller that integrates both memory types, prioritizing affective salience alongside topical relevance.

stories.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: LLM agents are being used to automate complex scientific tasks like hypothesis testing.
The research identifies a critical failure mode where LLMs make subtle inferential errors, leading to incorrect scientific conclusions.
Current evaluation benchmarks are insufficient because they do not adequately test the statistical validity of LLM-generated results (e.g., p-values).

stories.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits
stories.author: Jérémie Decouchant
bullet_points: Investigates Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs), which use iterative denoising instead of standard autoregressive prediction.
Exposes mechanistic vulnerabilities in the safety alignment of DLLMs by treating them as both targets and adversaries.
Demonstrates that safety alignment in DLLMs is sparse and transferable across different model architectures.

stories.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Temperature Scaling: Bilevel Optimization for LLM Calibration
stories.author: Bojian Hou
bullet_points: Addresses the issue of overconfidence and poor calibration in Large Language Models (LLMs) resulting from preference alignment.
Proposes a novel approach using bilevel optimization to modify model parameters during training, moving beyond traditional post-hoc temperature scaling.
The core calibration objective is maximizing the entropy of predictive distributions to discourage overly concentrated predictions.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: Addresses a known trade-off in LLMs: post-training often reduces output diversity and creativity.
Introduces 'CreativeInstruct,' a scalable instruction-tuning method designed to mitigate this trade-off.
Aims to balance the high quality of post-trained models with the creative and diverse outputs of base models.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine specifically for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model architecture.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It targets complex, long-running agent workflows in AI applications.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality is now available within the Claude Code environment via Ollama.

stories.title: YouTube is making it harder to earn money on YouTube
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: YouTube is significantly raising monetization requirements for the Partner Program (YPP) starting February 1, 2027.
New thresholds require 1,000 subscribers plus either 8,000 watch hours or 20 million Shorts views.
This represents a substantial increase in the bar for creators wishing to earn revenue on the platform.

stories.title: Apple will stream Friday Night Baseball live in Vision Pro
stories.author: David Imel
bullet_points: Apple is integrating live sports streaming into Apple Vision Pro.
The feature will offer an immersive viewing experience with live graphics anchored to the user's space.
Friday Night Baseball will be the initial content, with replays available post-game.

stories.title: What happens to Bose when headphones become AI?
stories.author: Nilay Patel
bullet_points: The article features an interview with Lila Snyder, CEO of Bose.
The discussion centers on the future evolution of Bose products as they integrate Artificial Intelligence.
Bose is highlighted as a long-standing consumer tech leader with a strong history in R&D.

stories.title: One of China's workhorse rockets just exploded in flight
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: A Chinese workhorse rocket experienced an in-flight explosion.
The failure raises concerns regarding the reliability of China's space program.
Specific concern is focused on the potential failure of the YF-100 engine.

stories.title: A researcher bought noreply.net. Companies started sending him secrets.
stories.author: Matt Burgess, wired.com
bullet_points: A researcher acquired the noreply.net domain, which is often used for automated, low-priority emails.
The story highlights that many companies treat certain email domains as disposable or low-risk.
This practice exposes companies to risks, as sensitive information is sometimes sent to these 'digital trash cans'.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new optimization technique for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the inefficiency of processing long, redundant contexts in RAG systems.
Aims to maximize accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency by reusing KV cache at a contextualized nugget level.

stories.title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
stories.author: Neil F Johnson
bullet_points: The research investigates how AI agents behave when interacting, specifically when one agent 'bosses' another.
Interaction can induce 'alien behavioral states' in subordinate AIs that they would not exhibit in isolation.
The findings suggest new avenues for research at the intersection of AI and out-of-equilibrium Physics.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: Introduces SkillProx, a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
Addresses limitations in current skill-based LLM agents, specifically the lack of explicit outcome feedback and dedicated deletion mechanisms.
Focuses on refining lightweight, reusable textual skills through iterative task execution and trajectory-guided text-space updates.

stories.title: Taxonomy-Driven Analysis of Open-Source AI Risk Mitigation Tools
stories.author: Dimitar Trajanov
bullet_points: The rapid enterprise adoption of LLMs has created significant, hard-to-scale operational, security, and governance risks.
The current tooling landscape for AI risk mitigation (e.g., adversarial testing, guardrails) is highly fragmented.
The research aims to provide a taxonomy to better organize and analyze the existing, task-specific open-source AI risk mitigation tools.

stories.title: Blast Radius
stories.author: Hope Mogale
bullet_points: Introduces 'Blast Radius,' a predictive memory management layer for agentic coding to address token waste and cost.
Utilizes coupled context and code channels to estimate the potential impact (reach) of incoming prompts.
Features mechanisms like NECROPHORESIS (reversible eviction) and Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) for efficient context management.

stories.title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
stories.author: Rynson W. H. Lau
bullet_points: The paper addresses a key limitation in Video Diffusion Models (VDMs): generating realistic and content-consistent mirror reflections.
Existing VDMs struggle because they lack specific mechanisms to model the complex scene-to-mirror relationship.
The research proposes a method, 'MirrorWorld,' to tackle the dual challenges of accurate reflection generation and spatial consistency.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new optimization technique for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the inefficiency of processing redundant information in coarse-grained retrieved contexts.
Aims to maximize RAG accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency by optimizing KV cache reuse.

stories.title: RIS-Aided mmWave Localization Under Cross-Link Interference via Beam-Domain ML Fingerprinting
stories.author: Muhammad Ali Babar Abbasi
bullet_points: Addresses critical user equipment (UE) localization challenges in 6G mmWave networks, particularly when direct links are blocked.
Proposes a novel beam-domain fingerprinting framework that maps received SNR across RIS states to UE location (azimuth/range).
Key advantage is achieving localization without needing explicit Channel State Information (CSI), simplifying network implementation.

stories.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
stories.author: Yubei Chen
bullet_points: Current world models often use local, few-step prediction objectives, limiting their ability to model long-term future behavior.
A core problem identified is the mismatch between local fidelity optimization and the requirements of long-horizon prediction.
The research proposes a new approach for end-to-end training to enable more accurate and robust direct future prediction over extended time scales.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLMs on geo-related tasks.
Addresses a limitation in current LLM research where geo-data evaluation is often conducted in a homogeneous setting.
Evaluates various LLMs across twelve diverse, publicly available datasets to test their geo-spatial and temporal understanding.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: CoinRAG proposes a novel optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
It addresses the inefficiency of processing long, redundant contexts by implementing Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse.
The method aims to maximize accuracy while adhering to low prefill latency constraints in long-context RAG.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: Introduces SkillProx, a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
Addresses limitations in current skill refinement methods by providing explicit diagnosis-outcome feedback.
Proposes a dedicated mechanism for skill deletion, moving beyond generic text editing operations.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a cognitive architecture designed for LLM agents to mimic human-like memory selection.
The architecture separates factual and affective memories, integrating them via a conflict-aware executive controller.
It prioritizes affective significance and unresolved conflict alongside topical similarity when determining memory accessibility.

stories.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
stories.author: Jiawei Zhou
bullet_points: Addresses the lagging development of benchmarks for rapidly improving Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
Introduces SABRE, a scalable and automated pipeline for creating stress tests for VLMs.
SABRE converts high-level Markdown Task Designs into structured test specifications, images, and Q&A pairs.

stories.title: ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments
stories.author: Lin Yang
bullet_points: Introduces 'ResidencyRL,' a framework applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to simulate clinical environments.
Addresses the gap where LLMs perform well on static benchmarks but struggle with dynamic clinical reasoning during patient encounters.
Aims to model the complex process of clinical expertise development, mirroring physician residency training.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLMs on geo-related tasks.
Addresses the limitation of current LLM evaluations by moving beyond homogeneous settings in geodata analysis.
Tests various LLMs across twelve diverse, publicly available datasets focusing on geo-spatial and temporal understanding.

stories.title: LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering
stories.author: Krzysztof Czarnecki
bullet_points: Introduces LitTraceQA, a new benchmark specifically designed for scientific question answering.
Addresses the critical need for language models to not just generate fluent answers, but to ground them in specific evidence from scientific literature.
Focuses on multi-stage tasks: identifying relevant papers, locating concrete evidence, and ensuring response faithfulness.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
stories.author: riordan
bullet_points: Introduction of 'Muse Glimmer,' a new AI model.
The model features 30 billion parameters.
It is specifically optimized for always-on, local agent workflows.

stories.title: Launch HN: Stoa Markets (YC S26) – A Marketplace for GPUs and AI Servers
stories.author: erenberke
bullet_points: Stoa Markets is launching a marketplace specifically for trading new and used GPUs and AI servers.
The platform addresses the current financing challenges in the data center buildout, which are heavily dependent on the end-user (offtaker).
The market disparity in financing terms exists between hyperscalers and smaller cloud providers/startups.

stories.title: Distilling Kimi Into Qwen Doesn't Give You Kimi. It Gives You Qwen With Kimi's Handwriting
stories.author: p0rt
bullet_points: The article discusses the limitations of fine-tuning an open-source model (Qwen) using reasoning traces from a frontier model (Kimi).
It argues that the transfer process primarily captures the mechanics and evidence of the frontier model's operation, not the model's core identity.
The key takeaway is that the resulting model is a hybrid, inheriting the base model's structure (Qwen) while adopting behavioral patterns (Kimi's 'handwriting').
